verdict.rationale: Skyvern is code-first. It offers Python, TypeScript and REST interfaces that run tasks programmatically against a cloud Chromium instance over CDP. It can also be self-hosted on your own servers with your own LLM keys, so automations run without the dashboard. That is the core of headless automation from scripts or pipelines. missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI pipeline usage (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), an explicit headless-mode or CLI reference, independent hands-on corroboration of CI runs.
